document.abstract: There are presently two competing storage media for television programs: magnetic tape and motion-picture film. Much literature has appeared recently concerning both the electronic and mechanical design features of magnetic-tape machines, but progress on film scanning equipment for television has not remained static at former development stages. During the past ten years, a fast-pulldown mechanism for a television film scanner without optical compensation has been developed. Its operating principle and performance are discussed.
